a: It refers to when there are 2 or more cards with the same level among all of the stacked cards.
Examples include when a level 5 Digimon has a level 5 digivolution card or when a level 6 Digimon has 2 level 5 digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: What does "if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards" mean, exactly?

q: I have EX5-064 [Koh & Sayo] in the battle area.
Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to play BT22-102 [Sayo]?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards, you may play 1 Tamer card with the [Night Claw] or [Light Fang] trait from your hand without paying the cost. This effect can't play cards with the same name as any of your Tamers.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with the [Night Claw], [Light Fang] or [Galaxy] trait would be deleted, by trashing 2 same-level cards from its digivolution cards, it isn't deleted.
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[Night Claw]/[Light Fang]/[CS] trait: Cost 2
